newsitem.title: USA: National Record Nov same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: National Record Nov same-store sales up.

text.p: National Record Mart Inc said Thursday that same-stores sales were up 9.2 percent in November from the same period last year.
For the four weeks ended November 30, the company reported total sales increased 10.l percent.
National Record said that during the Thanksgiving weekend sales increased six percent from a year earlier.
The company said it would continue to focus on stores and development of the operating management team to provide the platform into the consolidating music retail business.
